title: Submission-only constraints
description: The Assessment schema describes both the body posted to /assessment and the body returned by it. `id` and `uri` are assigned by the server, and are marked `readOnly` in the OpenAPI spec — but `readOnly` is an annotation in JSON Schema, not an assertion, so no validator rejects them on input. Combined with the base schema using allOf for the `submit` validation type, this makes them illegal on submission. Written as false-valued properties rather than `not`/`required` because that is what makes the validator report the error against `/id` or `/uri` instead of against the document root; in a report of this size, pointing at the offending property is worth more than a prettier sentence. It declares no properties of its own that the base does not already know, so it does not interact with the base schema's `additionalProperties: false`.
